## 2. Purposes.-  
HBA is admissible for only one of the following purposes:-  
- (1) Constructing a new house on the plot owned by the employee husband jointly with
2. or the employee and the employee's wife/ the clear title of the plot.

4. Purchasing a plot and constructing a house thereon.
- (3) Purchasing a plot under co-operative Schemes and constructing a house/flat thereon or acquiring a house through membership of Co-operative Group Housing Societies.
